rulings.Case Title: THE ESTATE OF TRACEY ANN JONES
rulings.Calendar Matter: ACCOUNTING PETITION RE: Accounting #1, Report, Fees, Final Distribution
rulings.Rulings: Granted per written order, although the sixth amended petition was not e-filed until 7/1/26, and notice was mailed on 7/2/26 neither of which date was at least 15 days before this hearing. The Court waives defective notice in order for this estate to close. Paragraph 12 of the sixth amended petition and the prayer still refer to an "account," although accounting was waived. The assets on hand were shown as of 9/30/24, not 6/30/24. The I&A was filed on 10/24/23, not 10/23/23. The "Supplemental" I&A filed on 6/30/26 appears to be a Corrected I&A, showing all assets of the estate again, not just the additional (supplemental) asset. An order, until it is signed by a judicial officer, IS just a proposed order; there is no need to call it a "proposed" order.

rulings.Case Title: THE ESTATE OF JEFFERY D. PEARL
rulings.Calendar Matter: ACCOUNTING PETITION RE: Accounting #1, Report, Fees, Final Distribution
rulings.Rulings: Continued to 8/24/26. (No earlier availability.) Issue(s) necessitating continuance: (1) Please explain the disbursements to the estate accountant and Phoenix Fiduciary Services. Fees paid to another to prepare the estate account must be deducted from the executor's statutory compensation. (2) The filing fee for this petition was $435 and the e-filing fee should not have been more than $9.50. (3) Is the executor requesting reimbursement for final filing fees totaling $550? That is unclear in the proposed order. Please provide a revised proposed order, if appropriate, and courtesy copies of the petition and any papers filed to address these issues to the assigned examiner by 810/26. The accounting and most of the bank statements have not yet been reviewed in detail, as no courtesy copies were provided, as required by LRSF 2.7 B. and 14.7 B. Only the statement(s) verifying the ending balance(s) in an accounting is/are required to be filed. Examiner continuances are final and not subject to contest under LRSF 14.10 B. (Item 4 of an I&A should NOT be completed when a probate referee HAS BEEN appointed. Item 4 of the I&A is ONE sentence.) NB: In order for this Court to track closed matters, orders to terminate and distribute an estate must begin with the following language: "Order for Final Distribution." [LRSF 14.35 I.6.b.]
